questions.question: Which method can be used to manually request a refresh of the content cards in iOS?
questions.explanation: In iOS, BrazeKit.ContentCards.refresh() is the proper method to manually refresh content cards.

questions.question: A developer wants to update a user's preferred_theme to dark in their iOS Swift app. Which code snippet correctly sets this custom attribute?
questions.explanation: The correct iOS SDK syntax is AppDelegate.braze?.user.setCustomAttribute(key:value:) to set custom attributes.
